rows.text: with `o` = `rcx`: for each qword `p` of the range qword `[o]`..qword `[o+8]` it skips a null `p`, else calls `00210EB0(qword [p+8])` and `00809950(p, 0x18)`; then calls `00210EB0(qword [o])`; for each qword `p` of the range qword `[o+0x10]`..qword `[o+0x18]` it skips a null `p`, else calls `00210EB0` on qwords `[p+8]`, `[p+0x18]` and `[p+0x28]` and then `00809950(p, 0x50)`; finally tail-jumps to `00210EB0(qword [o+0x10])`; no pointer it frees is cleared
